empty-text.description: text displayed when data is void
empty-text.description_zh: 内容为空的时候展示的文本

node-key.description: unique identity key name for nodes, its value should be unique across the whole tree
node-key.description_zh: 每个树节点用来作为唯一标识的属性，整棵树应该是唯一的

:props.description: configuration options, see the following table

render-after-expand.description: whether to render child nodes only after a parent node is expanded for the first time
render-after-expand.description_zh: 是否在第一次展开某个树节点后才渲染其子节点

:load.description: method for loading subtree data, only works when `lazy` is true
:load.description_zh: 加载子树数据的方法，仅当 lazy 属性为true 时生效

:render-content.description_zh: 树节点的内容区的渲染 Function

highlight-current.description_zh: 是否高亮当前选中节点，默认值是 false。

default-expand-all.description: whether to expand all nodes by default
default-expand-all.description_zh: 是否默认展开所有节点

expand-on-click-node.description: whether to expand or collapse node when clicking on the node, if false, then expand or collapse node only when clicking on the arrow icon.
expand-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候展开或者收缩节点， 默认值为 true，如果为 false，则只有点箭头图标的时候才会展开或者收缩节点。

check-on-click-node.description: whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on the node, if false, the node can only be checked or unchecked by clicking on the checkbox.
check-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候选中节点，默认值为 false，即只有在点击复选框时才会选中节点。

auto-expand-parent.description: whether to expand father node when a child node is expanded
auto-expand-parent.description_zh: 展开子节点的时候是否自动展开父节点

:default-expanded-keys.description: array of keys of initially expanded nodes
:default-expanded-keys.description_zh: 默认展开的节点的 key 的数组

check-strictly.description: whether checked state of a node not affects its father and child nodes when `show-checkbox` is `true`
check-strictly.description_zh: 在显示复选框的情况下，是否严格的遵循父子不互相关联的做法，默认为 false

:default-checked-keys.description: array of keys of initially checked nodes
:default-checked-keys.description_zh: 默认勾选的节点的 key 的数组

:filter-node-method.description: this function will be executed on each node when use filter method. if return `false`, tree node will be hidden.
:filter-node-method.description_zh: 对树节点进行筛选时执行的方法，返回 true 表示这个节点可以显示，返回 false 则表示这个节点会被隐藏

accordion.description: whether only one node among the same level can be expanded at one time
accordion.description_zh: 是否每次只打开一个同级树节点展开

:indent.description: horizontal indentation of nodes in adjacent levels in pixels
:indent.description_zh: 相邻级节点间的水平缩进，单位为像素

lazy.description: whether to lazy load leaf node, used with `load` attribute
lazy.description_zh: 是否懒加载子节点，需与 load 方法结合使用

draggable.description: whether enable tree nodes drag and drop
draggable.description_zh: 是否开启拖拽节点功能

:allow-drag.description: this function will be executed before dragging a node. If `false` is returned, the node can not be dragged

:allow-drop.description: this function will be executed before the dragging node is dropped. If `false` is returned, the dragging node can not be dropped at the target node. `type` has three possible values: 'prev' (inserting the dragging node before the target node), 'inner' (inserting the dragging node to the target node) and 'next' (inserting the dragging node after the target node)
:allow-drop.description_zh: 拖拽时判定目标节点能否被放置。`type` 参数有三种情况：'prev'、'inner' 和 'next'，分别表示放置在目标节点前、插入至目标节点和放置在目标节点后

methods.name: filter
methods.description: filter all tree nodes, filtered nodes will be hidden
methods.params: Accept a parameter which will be used as first parameter for filter-node-method
methods.description_zh: 对树节点进行筛选操作

methods.name: updateKeyChildren
methods.description: set new data to node, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: (key, data) Accept two parameters: 1. key of node 2. new data
methods.description_zh: 通过 keys 设置节点子元素，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: getCheckedNodes
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently selected array of nodes
methods.params: (leafOnly, includeHalfChecked) Accept two boolean type parameters: 1. default value is `false`. If the parameter is `true`, it only returns the currently selected array of sub-nodes. 2. default value is `false`. If the parameter is `true`, the return value contains halfchecked nodes
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前被选中的节点所组成的数组

methods.name: setCheckedNodes
methods.description: set certain nodes to be checked, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: an array of nodes to be checked
methods.description_zh: 设置目前勾选的节点，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: getCheckedKeys
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently selected array of node's keys
methods.params: (leafOnly) Accept a boolean type parameter whose default value is `false`. If the parameter is `true`, it only returns the currently selected array of sub-nodes.
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前被选中的节点的 key 所组成的数组

methods.name: setCheckedKeys
methods.description: set certain nodes to be checked, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: (keys, leafOnly) Accept two parameters: 1. an array of node's keys to be checked 2. a boolean parameter. If set to `true`, only the checked status of leaf nodes will be set. The default value is `false`.
methods.description_zh: 通过 keys 设置目前勾选的节点，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: set node to be checked or not, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: (key/data, checked, deep) Accept three parameters: 1. node's key or data to be checked 2. a boolean typed parameter indicating checked or not. 3. a boolean typed parameter indicating deep or not.
methods.description_zh: 通过 key / data 设置某个节点的勾选状态，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: getHalfCheckedNodes
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently half selected array of nodes
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前半选中的节点所组成的数组

methods.name: getHalfCheckedKeys
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently half selected array of node's keys
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前半选中的节点的 key 所组成的数组

methods.name: getCurrentKey
methods.description: return the highlight node's key (null if no node is highlighted)
methods.description_zh: 获取当前被选中节点的 key，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性，若没有节点被选中则返回 null

methods.name: getCurrentNode
methods.description: return the highlight node's data (null if no node is highlighted)
methods.description_zh: 获取当前被选中节点的 data，若没有节点被选中则返回 null

methods.name: setCurrentKey
methods.description: set highlighted node by key, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: (key, shouldAutoExpandParent=true) 1. the node's key to be highlighted. If `null`, cancel the currently highlighted node 2. whether to automatically expand parent node
methods.description_zh: 通过 key 设置某个节点的当前选中状态，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: setCurrentNode
methods.description: set highlighted node, only works when `node-key` is assigned
methods.params: (node, shouldAutoExpandParent=true) 1. the node to be highlighted 2. whether to automatically expand parent node
methods.description_zh: 通过 node 设置某个节点的当前选中状态，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: get node by data or key
methods.description_zh: 根据 data 或者 key 拿到 Tree 组件中的 node

methods.name: remove
methods.description: remove a node, only works when node-key is assigned
methods.params: (data) the node's data or node to be deleted
methods.description_zh: 删除 Tree 中的一个节点，使用此方法必须设置 node-key 属性

methods.name: append
methods.description: append a child node to a given node in the tree
methods.params: (data, parentNode) 1. child node's data to be appended 2. parent node's data, key or node
methods.description_zh: 为 Tree 中的一个节点追加一个子节点

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: insert a node before a given node in the tree
methods.params: (data, refNode) 1. node's data to be inserted 2. reference node's data, key or node
methods.description_zh: 为 Tree 的一个节点的前面增加一个节点

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: insert a node after a given node in the tree
methods.params: (data, refNode) 1. node's data to be inserted 2. reference node's data, key or node
methods.description_zh: 为 Tree 的一个节点的后面增加一个节点

events.name: node-click
events.description: triggers when a node is clicked
events.params: four parameters: node object corresponding to the node clicked, `node` property of TreeNode, TreeNode itself, event object

events.name: node-contextmenu
events.description: triggers when a node is clicked by right button
events.params: four parameters: event, node object corresponding to the node clicked, `node` property of TreeNode, TreeNode itself
events.description_zh: 当某一节点被鼠标右键点击时会触发该事件

events.name: check-change
events.description: triggers when the selected state of the node changes
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the node whose selected state is changed, whether the node is selected, whether node's subtree has selected nodes
events.description_zh: 节点选中状态发生变化时的回调

events.name: check
events.description: triggers after clicking the checkbox of a node
events.params: two parameters: node object corresponding to the node that is checked / unchecked, tree checked status object which has four props: checkedNodes, checkedKeys, halfCheckedNodes, halfCheckedKeys
events.description_zh: 当复选框被点击的时候触发

events.name: current-change
events.params: two parameters: node object corresponding to the current node, `node` property of TreeNode
events.description_zh: 当前选中节点变化时触发的事件

events.name: node-expand
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the node opened, `node` property of TreeNode, TreeNode itself
events.description_zh: 节点被展开时触发的事件

events.name: node-collapse
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the node closed, `node` property of TreeNode, TreeNode itself
events.description_zh: 节点被关闭时触发的事件

events.name: node-drag-start
events.params: two parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, event.
events.description_zh: 节点开始拖拽时触发的事件

events.name: node-drag-enter
events.description: triggers when the dragging node enters another node
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the entering node, event.
events.description_zh: 拖拽进入其他节点时触发的事件

events.name: node-drag-leave
events.description: triggers when the dragging node leaves a node
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the leaving node, event.
events.description_zh: 拖拽离开某个节点时触发的事件

events.name: node-drag-over
events.description: triggers when dragging over a node (like mouseover event)
events.params: three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dragging over node, event.
events.description_zh: 在拖拽节点时触发的事件（类似浏览器的 mouseover 事件）

events.name: node-drag-end
events.params: four parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dragging end node (may be `undefined`), node drop type (before / after / inner), event.
events.description_zh: 拖拽结束时（可能未成功）触发的事件

events.name: node-drop
events.description: triggers after the dragging node is dropped
events.params: four parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dropped node, node drop type (before / after / inner), event.
events.description_zh: 拖拽成功完成时触发的事件

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom content for tree nodes. The scope parameter is { node, data }
slots.description_zh: 自定义树节点的内容，参数为 { node, data }

slots.name: empty
slots.description: empty you can customize content when data is empty.
slots.description_zh: 数据为空时的自定义内容

props.name: label
props.description: specify which key of node object is used as the node's label
props.description_zh: 指定节点标签为节点对象的某个属性值

props.name: children
props.description: specify which node object is used as the node's subtree
props.description_zh: 指定子树为节点对象的某个属性值

props.name: disabled
props.description: specify which key of node object represents if node's checkbox is disabled
props.description_zh: 指定节点选择框是否禁用为节点对象的某个属性值

props.name: isLeaf
props.description: specify whether the node is a leaf node, only works when lazy load is enabled
props.description_zh: 指定节点是否为叶子节点，仅在指定了lazy属性的情况下生效
